name: Acarbose
description: An intestinal alpha-glucosidase inhibitor that slows carbohydrate absorption, approved for type 2 diabetes. Minimally absorbed systemically.

systems.note: Blunted postprandial glucose excursion; the labelled indication.
Dose-related transaminase elevation is labelled and is the reason for labelled hepatic monitoring.

monitors.why: Labelled dose-related transaminase elevation with explicit monitoring instruction.
